{"type": "answer_plan", "interpretation": "Answer to: Compare 2025 revenue across company size tiers.", "sql": "SELECT c.company_size, SUM(i.amount) AS total_revenue
FROM invoices i
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
WHERE i.status = 'paid'
  AND i.invoice_date >= '2025-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.company_size"}
